candidates.topic: Why Are There So Many Food Recalls Lately? — 2026 Recall Surge Explainer
candidates.recommended_angle: Data-driven, skeptical explainer: assess whether recall frequency is actually rising or just detection/classification improving, using the Aug 2026 egg/blueberry/lettuce cluster as the hook.
candidates.why_now: Google Trends 'food safety' hit 99/100 with a +78-point 7-day spike — the largest movement of any tracked category — directly driven by three concurrent Class I/outbreak events (egg Salmonella, Publix blueberry upgrade, Cyclospora lettuce) plus NewsNation already asking the same question publicly.
candidates.primary_headline: Why Do There Suddenly Seem to Be So Many Food Recalls? Here's What the Data Shows
candidates.next_steps: Assign to writer today; pull FDA recall database counts YoY for the causation-vs-detection framing; confirm blueberry contaminant type before publishing.
integrity_flags: Do not imply causation between the egg, blueberry, and lettuce recalls — each has a distinct pathogen/root cause; frame as a volume/pattern observation only.
Confirm exact contaminant in the Publix blueberry recall (not specified in current source set) before publishing.
Attribute the 'recalls aren't a success story' framing directly to the named former FDA official quoted by NewsNation — do not present as unattributed staff opinion.
candidates.trend_score_reason: Google Trends 'food safety' 99/100 with +78 7-day delta; three concurrent Class I/outbreak events (egg, blueberry, lettuce) in one month.
candidates.opportunity_score_reason: High audience pain point (grocery shopper concern); strong news cycle velocity; data-explainer format fits core editorial strength; SEO keyword demand evident from Trends spike.
candidates.discover_score_reason: Highest possible: pattern-angle is differentiated from individual recall coverage; meta-question ('why so many?') is what audience is already searching for; tier-1 sources available.
candidates.notes: Distinct from prior existing coverage of individual recalls (egg 8/20, blueberry 8/20, lettuce 8/22) — this is the aggregate/pattern angle, not a repeat. Estimated word count 1,100–1,400; schema Article + FAQPage; primary keyword 'why are there so many food recalls'.
